actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. (text: CR S4567)

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Pennington County, South Dakota, and federal land management agencies.
dimensions.evidence: convey to Pennington County, South Dakota, certain National Forest System land

dimensions.assessment: The effect is limited to transferring ownership of about 8.97 acres of land for local public use.
dimensions.evidence: parcel of approximately 8.97 acres of National Forest System land

dimensions.assessment: The land is to be conveyed without consideration, meaning no financial payment is required from the county.
dimensions.evidence: convey to the County, without consideration

dimensions.assessment: Applies a one-time land conveyance and a localized boundary modification for the Black Hills National Forest.
dimensions.evidence: modify the boundary of the Black Hills National Forest to reflect the conveyance

dimensions.assessment: The land transfer is permanent, but its reach is strictly local to Pennington County.
dimensions.evidence: convey to the County... all right, title, and interest of the United States

missing_information: Specific financial costs or administrative expenses related to the conveyance are not mentioned.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the transfer of a specific 8.97-acre parcel of federal land to Pennington County, South Dakota, affecting a single local government entity and a minor tract of land.

latest_action.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
